notes.title: Wall Of Insanity update 1.22
notes.content:
Fixes in this build:

- Fixed inventory problem, preventing item to be picked to the empty slot
- Player now will not be launched to the space when breaking boxes
- Camera position is adjusted for better view
- Player model now becoming transparent, when it obscures camera view
- Grenades don't hurt the player. No more.
